title: HateMM: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Hate Video Classification
measurement_description: Detection of hateful video content, which includes content targeting various protected characteristics, including religion. The performance of models in identifying hate speech targeting Jews was specifically evaluated.
findings: The paper's multi-modal models were evaluated on their ability to detect hate speech against different target groups, including Jews. The vision-based model (ViT) performed well on videos targeting 'Jews', and the best multi-modal model (M1) showed consistently good performance for this target group. The study also identified visual hate speech cues related to religion, such as depicting a Jewish rabbi alongside hateful text.
